text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The day of the Sumire Stakes has<n>arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's a race that should pose no<n>difficulties for Super
Creek...<n>However, she isn't feeling well right<n>before
the start.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She manages to recover somewhat<n>by taking a nap
and heads to the<n>track with the intention of winning.
